brand.name: glowa
brand.madeIn: Built in Bulgaria, for the world

home.subtitle: Glowa is the modern platform for online booking, salon management and happier clients — all in one place.

foundation.title: What works today
foundation.body: The customer experience is live: search, business profiles, real-time booking, cancel and reschedule, reviews and calendar sync.

features.title: Built for the people who make
features.subtitle: Glowa gives you the tools to run, organise and grow your business — simply and effectively.

booking.title: Online booking
booking.body: Clients book around the clock, with no phone tag and no waiting.

teamCalendar.title: Calendar and team
teamCalendar.body: Run the whole team's schedule from one shared calendar.

clients.title: Client base
clients.body: History, notes and preferences for every client, in one place.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Online payments and deposits, ready to switch on.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.body: Automated messages and campaigns to your own clients.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: Track revenue, utilisation and growth without a spreadsheet.

assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.body: Answers questions about the business and helps you write.

growth.title: A partner in your growth.
growth.body: We think technology should hand back time for the part you actually love — your clients.
growth.point1: Set up in minutes, not weeks.
growth.point2: One calendar for the whole team and every location.
growth.point3: Bulgarian, English and Romanian from day one.

home.heroAlt: A client and stylist in a bright salon during a consultation
home.trustLine: Built in Bulgaria, for the world
